# 1. Purpose

# 2. Role Overview

- Role Name
- Organizational Unit
- Reporting Line
- Primary Responsibilities
- Scope of Authority

Role Name:

Architecture Owner

Reports To:

---

# 3. Responsibilities

Document all responsibilities.

Example:

- Define architecture
- Review specifications
- Approve standards
- Participate in governance reviews
- Support quality assurance

Responsibilities shall remain measurable.

---

# 4. Authorities

Describe the authority assigned to this role.

Example:

- Approve architecture
- Reject non-compliant designs
- Request design revisions
- Escalate governance issues

Authorities shall be documented explicitly.

---

# 5. Required Competencies

Example:

- Security
- Databases

- Leadership
- Communication
- Risk Management

- Enterprise Architecture
- Software Development

# 6. Interactions

- Management
- Development Teams
- Operations
- Security
- Quality Assurance

# 7. Accountability

- Deliverables
- Decisions
- Compliance
- Reviews
- Governance

Exactly one accountable owner shall exist for each defined responsibility.

# 8. Performance Indicators

- Review Completion Rate
- Compliance Score
- Architecture Quality
- Approval Time
- Audit Findings

Performance indicators shall be measurable.

# 9. Validation Requirements

Validation shall verify:

- role completeness
- responsibility assignment
- authority definition
- competency definition
- governance compliance
- documentation quality

Validation evidence shall be retained.
